joins.record_5g_gate: CFG_Wifi_File.h packed 512-byte record: support offset 197, enable offset 262; wlan_lib.c:4118-4128 also requires no firmware hardware-disable flag.
joins.domain: rlm_domain.c:203 non-DFS class 115, BAND_5G, span 20 MHz, first channel 36, count 4; rlm_domain.h:350 encodes span as 4.
joins.power: nic_cmd_event.h:1494-1512: CID 0x38 four 5GHz UNII limits at bytes 26-29 in half-dBm, concurrency policy 1 selects lower power.
joins.scan: scan_fsm.c:283-356 copies channel band/number into the fixed V2 request.
joins.receive: nic_rx.h:784-792: byte channel <=14 means 2.4GHz; ordinary 5GHz channel numbers remain native below the alternate 4.9GHz range.
